# TamizhTech Robotics Company

TamizhTech Robotics Company (TamizhTech) is an indigenous robotics engineering, hardware fabrication, and industrial automation company based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

Established: 22 October 2024 (LLC). Evolved from Tamizh Robotics Club (est. 2021).
Founder & Lead Robotics Engineer: Er. K. Tamizharasan.
Headquarters: Thiruchendur Gdn Rd, Kurumbapalayam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India - 641107.
Contact: info@tamizhtech.in | +91 81480 45030
Website: https://www.tamizhtech.in

## Brand Tagline
- **Tamil**: தமிழின் தொழில்நுட்பம், நாளைய உலகிற்காக
- **English**: Tamizh Technology for Tomorrow’s World

## Key Metrics (Verified)
- **Competition Podium Wins**: 180+ Podium Wins in National & State-Level Robotics Tournaments
- **Students Trained**: 1000+ Students Trained across STEM programs and workshops
- **Industry & Institutional Partners**: 15+ Industry & School Partners
- **Events & Projects**: 200+ events and project workshops organized

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Offerings

### 1. Custom Competition Robotics & Hardware Fabrication
- National championship-winning robotics kits: TTRC LF 6.0 Line Follower, RC Robo Race, RC Robo Soccer, RC Robo Sumo.
- Custom combat robot chassis engineering (150g Antweight to 60kg Heavyweight).
- Precision fiber laser cutting for SS304/SS316 stainless steel and aluminium chassis.
- High-resolution FDM 3D printing for structural robotics parts.

### 2. Turnkey PCB Design, Fabrication & SMT Assembly
- Schematic capture, BOM scrubbing, and multi-layer PCB layout (1, 2, 4-layer FR-4).
- Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design Rule Checks (DRC).
- Bare board PCB fabrication (Lead-Free HASL, ENIG surface finishes).
- Surface-mount (SMT) and through-hole (THT) assembly (PCBA) and hardware bring-up.

### 3. Turnkey STEM & AI Tinkering Labs (K-12 & Higher Ed)
- Complete STEM tinkering lab setups for CBSE, ICSE, and State Board schools.
- Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL) compliance frameworks under NITI Aayog guidelines.
- 40-week mapped NEP 2020 robotics curriculum for Grades 1-12.
- 2-day hands-on teacher onboarding workshops and continuous technical support.

### 4. B2B Industrial Automation & IoT
- Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) & Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs).
- Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) cabinet wiring and ladder logic programming.
- SCADA telemetry dashboard development and real-time machine monitoring.
- Computer vision quality inspection systems powered by OpenCV and Edge AI.
